notes: Fixed window-close stalls while playing by hiding the window immediately, closing the core gate before queue drain, stopping page polling, SIGKILLing active FFmpeg decode pipes, making metadata/artwork throttles interruptible, and bounding shutdown waits to 2.5s; added NEON SIMD resampling, persistent parallel DSP thread pool, UPnP renderer capability alignment, and AppKit UI refinements. · 修复播放中点击关闭会卡住的问题：关窗即刻隐藏并提前关闸请求核心停机、停止各页轮询、立即终止解码管道并中断元数据/封面限流等待，同时收紧收尾等待上限至 2.5 秒；同步包含 NEON SIMD 重采样、常驻多核 DSP 线程池、UPnP 渲染器能力适配及原生界面细节修复。
